page.overview:
Who is Aragorn I?

Aragorn I was the fifth Chieftain of the Dúnedain.

Aragorn I was born to Aravir in TA 2227 during the time of the Watchful Peace. After his father's death in TA 2319, Aragorn I succeeded him as the Chieftain of the Dúnedain.

Aragorn I's reign came to an early end when, in TA 2327, he became "lost in the wilderness" while hunting. It was later said in history that he was probably slain by the Wolves infesting Eastern Eriador, which remained an ever increasing danger in Eriador, even up to the Fourth Age.

After his early death, he was succeeded by his son, Araglas, who became the sixth Chieftain of the Dúnedain.
